findings.claim: src/ffi/http_types.rs changes multiple FFI boundary null-check expressions for req/resp, and the sensitive production change has no accompanying tests.
supporting_facts: Boundary expression changed: let req = non_null!(&mut *req ?= hyper_code::HYPERE_INVALID_ARG);
Boundary expression changed: let req = non_null!(&mut *req ?= std::ptr::null_mut());
Boundary expression changed: let resp = non_null!(&mut *resp ?= std::ptr::null_mut());
The changed production file is flagged as a sensitive production change without tests.
findings.limitation: Evidence shows explicit scanned boundary-expression changes and missing tests only; it does not prove an actual behavioral regression.
findings.review_action: Review the changed FFI boundary behavior and require focused null/invalid-argument edge-case tests or a clear coverage justification.
